subject: red pandas
one_liner: Four bamboo currencies, one account, and a territory boundary we hold on file.
brand_voice_notes: A neobank that has decided bamboo is a foreign currency and a red panda is a high-net-worth individual with catastrophic cash flow. Never acknowledges that its customers are animals; treats scent-marking as a compliance procedure and 4 kg of leaves per day as a settlement obligation. Every sentence is the tone of a bank explaining, patiently and without apology, a fee you have already paid. Absurdity is always stated as policy, never as a joke.

hero.h1: Hold four currencies. All of them bamboo.
hero.sub: Wah settles shoots, leaves, berries and the occasional egg at the mid-market rate, seven days a week. Your territory is verified by scent within two business days. Weekends carry a spread.

features.title: Interbank rates on bamboo
features.blurb: A red panda must consume roughly 4 kg of leaves a day to remain solvent. We have made that a currency pair. SHOOT/LEAF settles at the mid-market rate Monday through Friday and carries a 0.4% spread on weekends, when the forest is closed.

features.title: Territory verified by scent
features.blurb: Mark the perimeter of your range and we hold the boundary on file. Where two accounts overlap, the range is awarded to whichever marked most recently. Re-verification is required every 40 days, and immediately after rain. Rain is not a supported dispute reason.

features.title: The Metal card, milled from one billet
features.blurb: Stainless steel, 47 grams, brushed on both faces and engraved with your range coordinates. That is roughly 0.8% of your body weight, which is roughly the reason no Metal card has ever been recovered from a canopy. Replacements are 3 shoots.

pricing_tiers.name: Standard
pricing_tiers.tagline: For account holders who are not yet a priority.
perks: Card delivered in 9 to 40 business days, to a tree
Support answers during daylight, which is not when you are awake

pricing_tiers.name: Metal
pricing_tiers.tagline: The card weighs more than your forearm.
perks: All four bamboo currencies at the mid-market rate
Territory re-verification twice yearly, weather permitting
Lounge access at three Himalayan ridgelines

pricing_tiers.name: Ultra
pricing_tiers.tagline: For the eleven account holders who qualify.
perks: A relationship manager who has never seen a red panda
Concierge available on the ground floor only. Concierge will not climb.
Your declines are engraved and delivered by hand

testimonials.quote: I moved 4 kg of leaves into shoots on a Tuesday and the rate held all afternoon. By Wednesday I could not find the tree. The rate still held.

testimonials.title: Sole Occupant, Ridge 41 (Household of One)

testimonials.quote: Scent verification failed twice because it rained. Wah reclassified my range as contested and awarded it to my sister, who does not use the app. I have written a letter.

testimonials.title: Displaced Rightsholder, Eastern Slope

testimonials.quote: The Metal card is exquisite. It is at the bottom of a ravine. I think about it during the eleven hours a day I am asleep.

demo_screen_concept: The Wah account console, staged as a sheet of intaglio-printed banknotes. Four bamboo currency balances (SHOOT, LEAF, BERRY, EGG) rendered as engraved denomination plates with guilloché rosettes and corner numerals. A tabbed console: ACCOUNTS shows the four balances plus a territory status strip reading CONTESTED in cinnabar; EXCHANGE is a working FX converter with two currency selects, an amount field, a mid-market rate that ticks every few seconds and a weekend-spread notice; CARD shows the 47 g Metal card plate with a freeze toggle that overprints the card with a frost lattice and disables it. Underneath, a ruled ledger of transactions with filter chips (all / foraging / scent fees / declined) and a declined row that opens a modal engraved with the refusal reason.

images.rationale: Hero skipped because the day's direction is intaglio security printing: the hero medallion is a pure-CSS guilloche rosette and a photograph inside a banknote plate would fight it. Demo subject assets skipped because demo_screen_concept is a multi-currency account console (balances, an FX converter, a ruled ledger, a card freeze toggle), which is not photo-shaped. Full budget went to three testimonial headshots, the always-applicable fallback: deadpan corporate portraits of red pandas graded to the substrate cream so they sit inside rosette frames without breaking the engraved page.

items.prompt: Deadpan corporate headshot photograph of a single red panda, head and shoulders, facing the camera straight on with a flat neutral unimpressed expression, ears upright, head tilted very slightly. Editorial photograph, medium-format, soft even studio light, no drama, no whimsy. Desaturated warm low-contrast grade: plain flat banknote-cream #EDE6D4 backdrop with no texture and no vignette, the fur muted toward a dusty terracotta #B7431C, shadows falling toward deep intaglio green #16382A. Shallow depth of field, sharp on the eyes, subject centered, nothing else in frame. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no rendered UI screens, no props, no clothing, no borders.
items.judge: pass - correct subject, flat deadpan expression, backdrop reads as the substrate cream, no text artifacts, no generic-render tells

design_direction.style: Intaglio security printing, bureau-of-engraving daylight mode. The page is staged as an uncut sheet of banknotes issued by a neobank that has decided bamboo is a reserve currency and a red panda is a high-net-worth individual. One warm banknote substrate (#EDE6D4) runs the entire page with no dark mode, no glass, no backdrop blur, no clay volume, no bento lattice, no felt panels, no blister foil, no enamel plates, no drafting grid and no vellum scribe lines. Nothing on the page casts a shadow, because printed money has no depth. Nothing has a border radius above 2px, because banknotes are cut square. All structure is carried by engraved hairlines in intaglio green (#16382A) and by flat floods of the same green, never by shadow, never by gradient fills that read as light. The organising move is the note: every major section is a full-width banknote plate, hemmed top and bottom by a lathe rule (a 10px band of 1px repeating-linear-gradient hairlines at 3px pitch, the engine-turned border of a banknote) and carrying a Didone denomination numeral in its top-right corner, so sections arrive as currency rather than as cards. The core motif is the guilloché rosette: a set of concentric rings built in pure CSS from repeating-conic-gradient and repeating-radial-gradient at low opacity, never an image, used as the hero medallion, the feature index disc, the pricing tier seal, the testimonial portrait frame and the section ornament, so every discrete item on the page is stamped rather than placed. The second motif is the microtext strip: a 7px, 0.34em-letterspaced repetition of the account terms running as a hairline separator between blocks, legible only if the reader leans in, exactly as on a real note. Bodoni Moda sets the wordmark, headlines and every denomination numeral in high-contrast Didone at monumental sizes with central-bank confidence, tracking tightened to -0.02em at display sizes and set flush left against the lathe rule. Public Sans carries plain, faintly statutory body copy at 17px with a 1.62 line-height. Every figure that pretends to be account telemetry (balances, FX rates, spreads, range coordinates, scent-verification ages, tier prices) is set in Courier Prime with tabular figures inside recessed substrate wells one step darker than the plate, so it reads like the ledger, not marketing. One rationed cinnabar overprint (#B7431C) is quarantined strictly to non-liability telemetry (the SPECIMEN overprint, contested ranges, declined transactions, expired scent verification, the weekend spread, the withheld line in pricing) and appears nowhere decorative, so the only warm colour on a cold page is always the bank declining to be responsible. Motion is press-restrained: lathe rules draw in from the left once on reveal, guilloché rosettes rotate one quarter turn over 900ms on reveal and then stop forever, CTAs invert to a green flood with substrate type knocked out on hover, plates lift their hairline to full opacity on hover with no shadow and no scale change, the cinnabar SPECIMEN overprint fades up at its fixed rotation, sections fade up 6px with a 40ms stagger, all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion. No dark mode, no glass, no blur, no gradients on type, no clay shadow pairs, no offset sticker shadows, no bento lattice, no drafting hairline grids, no rubrication, no versals, no chenille patches, no charge columns, no tier nodes, no leg bands, no split-flap numerals, no HUD corner brackets, no drawing-sheet title blocks, no emoji. Reads like a bank that files a wild animal under 'client' and considers your ravine a place of settlement.

fonts.body: 'Public Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

design_direction.archetype: Multi-currency neobank product page issued as an uncut sheet of banknotes: a hero note with a monumental Didone claim over a guilloché medallion and a rate strip in typewriter mono, three feature notes indexed by rosette discs, testimonial notes with rosette-framed engraved portraits and account numbers, a three-tier fee schedule laid out as denominations under a single lathe rule, a closing issuance band with a cinnabar SPECIMEN overprint, and a handoff to the account console demo.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Lathe rules draw left to right once on reveal over 700ms. Guilloché rosettes rotate 90 degrees on reveal and then hold. Plates raise their hairline border opacity on hover with no lift, no scale, no shadow. Primary CTAs invert to an intaglio green flood with substrate type knocked out, and depress 1px on press. The cinnabar SPECIMEN overprint fades up at its fixed -14deg rotation. Sections fade up 6px on a 40ms stagger. Everything gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Full-bleed banknote plate on the substrate ground, hemmed top and bottom by lathe rules. Left column: a letterspaced Courier caption reading the issuing authority, then the Didone h1 at clamp(2.6rem, 7vw, 5.6rem) flush left, then the sub at a 62-character measure, then the primary CTA as a flat green flood beside a hairline ghost link to the demo. Right column: a large CSS guilloché medallion with the denomination numeral centred in Didone, and beneath it a four-row rate strip in Courier with tabular figures inside recessed wells, one row per bamboo currency, the weekend spread row in cinnabar. A rotated SPECIMEN overprint sits across the medallion at -14deg. Microtext strip closes the section.
